
DELETE-STEP
Delete a step from a scenario

USAGE
  fspec delete-step <file> <scenario> <index> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <scenario> (required)
    Scenario name
  <index> (required)
    Step index (0-based)

OPTIONS
  --force
    Skip confirmation

EXAMPLES
  1. Delete step
  $ fspec delete-step spec/features/login.feature "Login with valid credentials" 2
  ✓ Deleted step from scenario

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-step
  fspec update-step
